connector.name: MCP Server Scf
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the SCF Controls Platform - 83 tools for controls, evidence, risk, and TPRM.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server-scf. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace app.scfcontrolsplatform. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SCF_API_KEY
env.description: Your SCF Controls Platform API key. Generate in your self-hosted instance at Settings > API Keys. Starts with the scf_ prefix.

env.name: SCF_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of your self-hosted SCF Controls Platform instance (e.g. http://localhost:8000). Required — the platform is self-hosted; there is no hosted default.
